'''Josh Sands''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Washington State Championship]] on 22 April 2000 with SFS and X-Wing Swarm starting Holotable, according to Joe Olson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d588">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-washington-state-championships-longd588/ washington-state-championships-long], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 23 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-washington-state-championships-longd588/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
